title: Holy priest at 15 percent mana with mana potions: drinks one in the fight

rules.desc: A Holy priest at low mana that carries mana potions uses one (the potion's spell is Restore Mana) from 2 s before the fight starts to 30 s in
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/generic/UsePotionsStrategy.cpp:49-67 (medium mana and high mana -> mana potion at ACTION_EMERGENCY; the action is possible only with a potion in the bags and off cooldown); ai/playerbot/strategy/actions/UseItemAction.h:173-176 (UseManaPotionAction); TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649
rules.why_expect: 15 percent is under both mana lines (medium and high) and the row sits at ACTION_EMERGENCY, above every heal; the hire carries 3 potions. The bench accepts a potion from t -2 (a ready bot answers during the pull): rep1's wall-clock potion 0.24 s before fight_start counts. The 120 s item cooldown survives the per-rep `.cooldown` reset, so a potion inside an earlier rep's 120 s is carried as no opportunity (INCONCLUSIVE), not a miss. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev 0c56cf649; a FAIL points at the potion row or at the item not reaching the bags

rules.desc: Companion: the priest still casts at least 3 heals or shields on the player in the fight, so a bot that drinks the potion and then stalls fails
rules.why_expect: with the potion's mana back the healer has the pool for the same heals
